seal_status_note: This records WHICH packages sealed and at which commit. It is NOT a phase PASS: a phase passes only when its exit gate is met, and the exit gates live in the execution pack. Derived from programme/index.json — never hand-typed.

sealed_packages.invariant: every result ties to one exact source commit, package identity and raw-input hash set
every known blocker reproduces deterministically or is classified non-reproducible with missing evidence named
a failed critical test makes the authoritative CI gate fail
every case is classified against the versioned support envelope from intake facts alone
every possible terminal reason has an owner and a legal terminal-state mapping
no engineering task begins without a work-package issue card and rollback point
every writer, reader and mutator of the named state families is identified and classified
a gate run is side-effect free; regeneration happens only under an explicit flag
sealed_packages.note: one offender across all 192 registered suites

rollback: tag excel-inflow-v376-evidence-baseline; every package is an atomic commit

approvals.note: Approvals are HUMAN acts. Automation records the facts above; it does not approve a phase. Empty is the truthful state.
